body: [NeurIPS'23 Oral] Visual Instruction Tuning (LLaVA) built towards GPT-4V level capabilities and beyond.
plain_description: **Help teams analyze images through natural, visual question-and-answer conversations.** Run a local web demo or command-line interface, and fine-tune the model on custom data.
technical_description: LLaVA is a visual instruction tuning project for large language and vision models. It provides pretrained checkpoints, image chat via a Gradio web interface or CLI, model serving workers, evaluation tools, and scripts for pretraining and fine-tuning, including LoRA. The README documents GPU-based inference and training, with Apple M1/M2 MPS support and quantized 4-bit or 8-bit inference.
title: LLaVA: Large Language and Vision Assistant
